name: Moon Horror Den
summary: In Winterspring’s mountains northeast of Everlook, raging owlbeasts defend their den. Travelers who draw near the icy cave mouth meet wildkin guarding their home.

sections.title: A Den of Feathers and Frost
sections.body: Moon Horror Den opens in the mountain northeast of Everlook. Raging owlbeasts live within, fierce and at home in Winterspring’s harsh snows. Winterfall Village lies south, but a sheer mountain face bars the way. The den remains an isolated refuge, far from the paths travelers take.

faq.q: What creatures live in the Moon Horror Den?
aliases: what is in moon horror den
faq.answer: Raging owlbeasts live in Moon Horror Den. These large, aggressive wildkin are suited to Winterspring’s freezing climate, and they attack anyone who enters their cave.

faq.q: Where is the Moon Horror Den located?
aliases: how to find moon horror den
faq.answer: Moon Horror Den lies in eastern Winterspring, a short walk northeast of the goblin town of Everlook. Its mouth opens in the northern rock face.

faq.q: Can you reach Winterfall Village from the den?
faq.answer: No. A high mountain ridge blocks the way south to Winterfall Village. To reach the village, you must go around the mountain slopes through the open valley.

faq.q: Why do travelers venture into this cave?
aliases: why go to moon horror den
faq.answer: Travelers enter Moon Horror Den to hunt raging owlbeasts and help naturalists and researchers study Winterspring’s corrupted or aggressive wildkin.

angles.text: As a druid, you may find the owlbeasts’ violent frenzy sobering. It reflects the wild turbulence gripping Winterspring.
As a hunter, you face ferocious wildkin in the cave’s tight quarters. The thick-hided owlbeasts test your nerve up close.
